name: gmaps
description: Find businesses by what they are and where they are, collect a whole city, and export the list.

interface.longDescription: gmaps.dev finds businesses on the map, such as bakeries in Curitiba or dentists near a point, with their phones, websites, addresses, ratings and opening hours. Places saved from earlier searches come back at once. Before a whole-city collection starts, a quote says how many places it will gather. Your agent hands you the list as a csv, json or xlsx file. gmaps.dev is not affiliated with Google.
capabilities: Search businesses by type and area
Quote and collect a whole city
Export places as csv, json or xlsx
Check how much you used this month
defaultPrompt: Find 20 bakeries in Curitiba with their phones and websites.
Quote a collection of every dentist in Porto Alegre.
Export my last collection as a spreadsheet.
